name: PhotoCraft
short_desc: Image editing with layers, masks, type and real PSD files.
author: ArtCraft (storytold)
description: PhotoCraft is an open-source image editor that feels familiar to anyone who has used a professional photo editor: layers, masks, adjustments, type and real PSD files, written from scratch in Rust.

form_fields.label: Save in place
form_fields.hint: Chrome, Edge and Brave: Save writes back into the file you opened (or chose on the first save) instead of downloading a new copy each time. Turn off to keep the app's own downloads.
